app.name: MediSlot (doctor booking demo)
app.chooserSubtitle: Walk through booking your first appointment, or see how to manage the ones you already have.

tours.title: Booking an appointment
tours.description: Every step of the booking form, from choosing a service to confirming.

steps.title: Welcome to MediSlot
steps.body: Book a doctor in five short steps. We'll fill in an example as we go. Nothing is booked until you press Confirm yourself.

steps.title: Five steps
steps.body: Your progress shows here. Finished steps get a tick, and you can click one to go back and change it.

steps.title: Choose a service
steps.body: Pick the kind of doctor you need. We've chosen Dermatology for this example.

steps.title: In person, video or phone
steps.body: Video and phone appointments are often available sooner, and you don't need to travel.

steps.title: Your appointment so far
steps.body: This panel fills in as you go, so you can always see what you've chosen and what it will cost.

steps.title: Choose a doctor
steps.body: Each doctor shows their rating, languages, fee and next free day. Sort by soonest, rating or fee, or tick Any available doctor.

steps.title: Pick one
steps.body: We've picked Dr. Lucas Ferreira. Choosing a different doctor later clears the date and time you picked.

steps.title: Pick a day
steps.body: Days with a green dot have free times. Grey days are fully booked or the clinic is closed. We've picked the first free day.

steps.title: Pick a time
steps.body: Times that are crossed out are taken. We've picked the earliest free slot.

steps.title: Your details
steps.body: Name, date of birth and contact details let the clinic find your records and send reminders. We've filled in an example.

steps.title: Add your insurance
steps.body: Choose your insurer and the summary shows what you'll pay. We've picked BlueShield, which covers 80%.

steps.title: What you'll pay
steps.body: The fee, minus what your insurance covers. You pay at the clinic, not now.

steps.title: Privacy and reminders
steps.body: You need to accept this to continue. Reminders go out 24 hours before your appointment.

steps.title: Check everything
steps.body: One last look. Press Change on any row to jump back to that step.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Press Confirm appointment to book. You'll get a confirmation code and an email straight away.

tours.title: Managing your appointments
tours.description: Check in, reschedule, cancel and keep track of notifications.

steps.title: Your appointments
steps.body: Everything you've booked is here. The badge shows how many are coming up.

steps.title: Check in online
steps.body: From 24 hours before an in-person visit, check in here and skip the queue at the front desk.

steps.title: Upcoming and past
steps.body: Past visits keep their summary and a Book again button for follow-ups.

steps.title: One appointment
steps.body: The date, doctor, type and status. Pending means the clinic hasn't confirmed it yet. Video calls get a Join call button.

steps.title: Reschedule
steps.body: This takes you to the calendar with the same doctor already chosen, so you only pick a new time.

steps.title: Cancelling
steps.body: Tell us why and confirm. It's free up to 24 hours before. After that a late fee applies, and the dialog tells you which applies.

steps.title: Stay up to date
steps.body: Reminders, results and replies from your doctors appear here. The red badge counts the ones you haven't read.

steps.title: Your details
steps.body: Update your contact details, saved insurance and reminder settings. They're filled in for you every time you book.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.body: Press Help to replay this tour, or to walk through booking a new appointment.
